qualification.details: Medical Superintendent: A medical qualification included in the I or II Schedule or Part II of the third Schedule to the India Medical Council Act of 1956. A Postgraduate qualification, e.g., MD or MS or a recognized qualification equivalent thereto OR M.H.A (Master in Hospital Administration) or a post Graduate Degree recognized equivalent to M.H.A. Ten years' experience in Hospital Administration in Hospital after obtaining the P.G. Degree in a senior position, preferably in hospital with 300 beds. Executive Engineer (Electrical): Officers under the Central/State /U.T. Governments/ Universities/ Statutory /Autonomous Bodies or Research and Development Organizations holding analogous posts on regular basis OR Assistant Engineer (Electrical) with 5 years regular service in the grade pay of Rs. 5400/- OR Junior Engineer (Electrical) with 7 years regular service in the grade pay of Rs. 4600/-. Nursing Superintendent: Officers of the State/Central Government or Statutory/Autonomous Bodies holding analogous posts OR Deputy/Assistant Nursing Superintendent with five years of regular service in the Grade Pay of Rs. 5400/-. Accounts Officer: Officers under the Central/State /U.T. Governments/ Universities/ Statutory /Autonomous Bodies or Research and Development Organizations holding analogous posts on regular basis OR With 2/3 years regular service in the grade pay of Rs. 4800/- or 4600/- respectively in the relevant field. Administrative Officer: Officers under the Central/State /U.T. Governments/ Universities/ Statutory /Autonomous Bodies or Research and Development Organizations holding analogous posts on regular basis OR With 2/3 years regular service in the grade pay of Rs. 4800/- or 4600/- respectively in the relevant field. Assistant Accounts Officer: Officers under the Central/State /U.T. Governments/ Universities/ Statutory /Autonomous Bodies or Research and Development Organizations holding analogous posts on regular basis OR Junior Accounts Officer with five years of regular service in the grade pay of Rs. 4200/-.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Raebareli Non-Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the AIIMS Raebareli Various Non-Faculty Posts is 07 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Non-Faculty posts at AIIMS Raebareli?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies for various Non-Faculty posts released by AIIMS Raebareli.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the official address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts is 56 years.

faq.question: Q5. Does AIIMS Raebareli offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules for candidates belonging to reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the recruited candidates?
faq.answer: The salary structure ranges from Level-14 to Level-07 as per the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC).

faq.question: Q7. What are the educational qualifications required for the Medical Superintendent post?
faq.answer: For the Medical Superintendent post, a medical qualification with a PG degree and 10 years of hospital administration experience is required.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these Non-Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Test or Interview, followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for the AIIMS Raebareli Non-Faculty posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of AIIMS Raebareli, www.aiimsrbl.edu.in, and links are provided in the Important Links section.
